data.body: **P2:** When a chained target completes while this handler is in flight, `complete_chained_invoke()` records the operation ID, but `_finish_invocation()` first calls `record_invocation_completion()`, which clears the entire updated-ID list. This branch schedules the necessary follow-up, but its input omits that terminal ID from `UpdatedOperationIds`, so plugin and OTel update hooks miss the completion. Snapshot the IDs included in each invocation and clear only that snapshot so IDs added during the invocation survive.
